summary: Construct a shelter from foundation, posts, beams, roof and infill so support and enclosure can be inspected.
objective: From an isolated oblique view, trace roof-to-frame-to-ground connections without unexplained floating members.
example_prompts: Construct a shelter from foundation, posts, beams, roof and infill so support and enclosure can be inspected.

principles: Authored visual archetype: identify what supports, what encloses and what opens before choosing decorative motifs.
Repeat a bay dimension to give doors, posts and roof edges a shared scale; vary the silhouette without losing the assembly.
implementation: Create named foundation, frame, roof and infill groups. Place post feet at the foundation and give roof members visible bearing locations.
Give doors thickness, jambs and a hinge-side pivot. Reserve clearance through the opening before adding trim.
Represent joints with a few purposeful seams or brackets; use a removable wall or roof for inspection.
observable_checks: From an isolated oblique view, trace roof-to-frame-to-ground connections without unexplained floating members.
Open the door through its declared range; it clears jambs and can be closed to its saved rest pose.
Removing infill reveals the same frame, not a second disconnected interior model.

known_limits: A coherent visual assembly does not certify loads, joinery, weather resistance or construction safety.
Authored reusable guidance; no runtime artifact or improvement has been observed for this record.
creative_affordances: Adapt proportions, finish and presentation to the scene; explain deliberate departures from this guidance.
intent_signals: show how the roof connects to the shelter frame
